name: Doric's Quest (quest)

name: The Dig Site, The Lost Tribe and Another Slice of H.A.M. (quests)

name: Mining copper and tin ore
where: East Lumbridge Swamp mine or northern Dwarven Mines (South-east Varrock mine if banking for Smithing)
note: 17.5 xp each; 138 ores take you from 0 to 15 (F2P guide); the wiki gives no per-hour rate.
source: OSRS Wiki Free-to-play Mining training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11

name: Mining iron ore (free-to-play, Al Kharid Mine)
where: Al Kharid Mine (the only F2P tile with three iron rocks; level 14 scorpions there)
note: 35 xp per ore; the 41 and 61 xp/h figures are the F2P guide's stated maximums; the ore counts are our estimate (xp/h divided by 35).

name: Mining iron ore (triangle spots, then Mining Guild from 60)
where: Triangle iron spots such as Legends' Guild mine up to 60, then the Mining Guild
note: Low end of 45,000-55,000 xp/h below 60 and 70,000-80,000 from 60 without tick manipulation (P2P guide); the Ironman guide says over 82,000 with a dragon pickaxe in the Mining Guild; ore counts are our estimate (xp/h divided by 35).
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Ironman Guide/Mining; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11

name: Barronite shards and deposits
note: Shards give 16 xp and deposits 32 xp each; 18,000 is the low end of the observed 18,000-20,000 xp/h at level 75 with the Charm of Mining and Charm of Boost active.

name: 3-tick granite (3t4g)
where: Quarry (granite rocks in the south-west; Cape Conch route also named)
note: Tick manipulation is required (about 63,000 xp/h at best without it); values other than 99 come from the summarised part of the P2P guide; the UIM guide gives 125,000-130,000 at 99 with the Mining cape perk; an infernal pickaxe is the other option.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining; Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11

name: Gem rocks (Shilo Village mine)
where: Underground Shilo Village mine (Medium Karamja Diary needed)
note: Rates are without 3-tick mining, from the summarised P2P guide; 3-tick mining gives 89,000-110,000 xp/h; the Ironman guide says gem rocks are needed for expeditious bracelets.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining; Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11

name: Motherlode Mine
where: Motherlode Mine (reached via the Mining Guild per the P2P guide)
note: Rates are from the wiki's Motherlode Mine page table (2026-11-11); the UIM guide says it is not generally recommended for UIMs because they cannot bank pay-dirt ores.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining; Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11 ; xp OSRS Wiki Motherlode Mine 2026-11-11

name: Calcified rocks (Cam Torum mine)
note: Rates without tick manipulation come from the summarised P2P guide; the UIM guide gives about 90,000 Mining xp/h at 99 with 1.5-tick mining and Prayer xp from the shards; the pickaxe requirement is implied, not stated.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining; Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11

name: Crashed stars (shooting stars)

note: Xp is the base rune-pickaxe rate from the P2P guide; the stardust figures are with a crystal pickaxe; the F2P guide instead gives about 8,000-13,000 xp/h at 70 and says free players must world-hop to find stars.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Free-to-play Mining training; Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11 ; xp OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training 2026-11-11

name: Blast Mine
note: Rates from the summarised P2P guide (65,000-76,000 at 75 and 87,000-101,000 at 99); needs dynamite, a chisel and a tinderbox; the guide does not recommend runite below 75.

name: Volcanic Mine
note: Dragon-pickaxe rates from the summarised P2P guide; team activity costing 30 numulites per entry; the UIM guide gives 65,000-70,000 at 70 in a good team and the Ironman guide says it becomes viable at 85.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Mining training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining; Ironman Guide/Mining 2026-11-11

name: Amethyst crystals
